title: console: install answers say what the runtime served — `hotLoaded: false` reads "installed, loads at the next restart", and an upgrade waits for the new version's app
body:
Blocked-by: #12096

Filing gate ③: a foreseen follow-up of two objectstack cards that triage graded in the same round, objectstack-ai/objectstack#22695 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#22689. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** the `domain:ui` lane, once objectstack-ai/objectui#12096 lands. That PR edits the same page.

## Two readers on one page

The page is `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`.

1. **install-local's `hotLoaded`.**
   - The dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#12087 (`6098339059`) found, by code read, that the install-local refresh site has no rebuild window. objectstack-ai/objectui#12096 therefore leaves it unchanged: a `200` shows `marketplace.install.localSuccess` ("should now appear in the app switcher").
   - objectstack-ai/objectstack#22695 makes `data.hotLoaded` report whether the hot-register ran. It is `false` on the lenient path for a cloud-fetched manifest.
   - The page reads it. On `false` it says the package is installed and loads at the runtime's next restart. It does not claim the app is there.
   - `marketplaceApi.ts` already types `hotLoaded: boolean`.
2. **An upgrade's served version.**
   - objectstack-ai/objectui#12096 waits until an app whose `_packageId` equals the package's manifest id is served. On an upgrade, the stale kernel's OLD app already satisfies that.
   - objectstack-ai/objectstack#22689 has the registry path stamp `_packageVersion`. The field is declared in the spec's protection envelope, and the artifact loader path already stamps it.
   - When the served app carries `_packageVersion`, the wait's predicate also names the installed version. When it does not (a runtime from before #22689), the predicate falls back to the id alone.

## Acceptance

- **(1)** A test: a `200` with `hotLoaded: false` shows the restart wording, and does not refresh the app list as if the app were there. CONTROL: `hotLoaded: true` keeps today's wording.
- **(2)** A test on the virtual clock: an upgrade from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 keeps waiting while 1.0.0 is served, and refreshes once 1.1.0 is served. CONTROL: an app with no `_packageVersion` is accepted on the id, as today.
- New locale keys go into all ten packs.

## Order

Both readers are additive, so this card does not wait on an objectstack release, only on objectstack-ai/objectui#12096:
- against a runtime that predates the objectstack cards, (1) never sees `false`;
- (2) falls back to the id.

It imports no new spec type.
